I awoke to the sound of a shotgun falcon. I crept outside, feeling weighed down by the thick mountain air that surrounded me. I could feel the wind swirling around me, pushing me back as I tried to keep my footing. My mind raced, trying to remember why I had come here. Out far in the distance, a wolf emerged from the hillside, its eyes locked onto me. A throng of trees swayed as a hooting grouse took off, their harsh cackles echoing in the mountain peeks. I found myself rooted to the spot, listening intently to each low growl and chirp. I clutched my heart, feeling sure that I had walked into something unknown and dangerous.
